source.snippet: How can I determine and resolve a power automate application from timing out when receiving an email application? I can confirm process begins when email is received as I can receive a confirmation email. I tried saving to a network or sharepoint with same results. I have a for each loop to send email and create file.

problem_statement: Business users and IT generalists building Power Automate workflows hit silent timeout failures when connecting to network shares or SharePoint — with no clear diagnostic path — causing business automation to silently break and wasting significant troubleshooting time.
target_segment: IT generalists, operations staff, and business analysts at SMBs using Microsoft Power Automate to automate document and email workflows.
notes: Power Automate is a paid Microsoft product; users encountering this are already in a paid ecosystem. Time-waste is explicit ('I tried... same results' — indicating hours of iteration). Opportunity: diagnostic tool or template library for common Power Automate failure patterns, or an audit/fix service. Adjacent to the M365 MFA signal — same buyer persona (SMB IT admin / ops person in a Microsoft shop).
